_comment: Single source of truth for the bundled/downloaded xray-core version. Consumed by both .github/workflows/release.yml (release packaging) and py_modules/backend/src/xray_downloader.py (runtime self-heal) so the two can never drift. Bump 'version' deliberately in its own PR. 'sha256' is the expected hash of the release asset; when set to a non-null hex string the runtime downloader verifies it, when null verification is skipped. v26.7.28 supersedes v26.3.27: security + Hysteria2 client maturity (Gecko via salamander+packetSize, upstream PR #6198).
